objective: Correct Ctrl+drag so rotation is around the clicked terrain pivot with the scene vertical up vector as the rotation axis.

assumptions.scene_axes: x and z are horizontal, y is elevation/up.
assumptions.rotation_axis: Scene y axis through the terrain pivot.
assumptions.ctrl_drag_horizontal_motion: Mouse dx controls yaw rotation around the vertical axis.
assumptions.ctrl_drag_vertical_motion: Mouse dy is ignored for this rotation mode because the requested rotation axis is vertical only.

inputs.pivot: Ray intersection with current blended terrain mesh.

outputs.modified_behavior: Ctrl+drag orbits camera target and eye around the vertical line through the terrain pivot.

crs.input_crs: Unchanged from loaded viewer experiment, normally EPSG:3857
crs.crs_inference: No new geospatial input was introduced.

rasterization.resolution: Unchanged; uses the already-loaded viewer mesh resolution
rasterization.aggregation_rule: Unchanged; minimum z for Cloud DEM rasterization in the project pipeline
rasterization.validity_mask: Finite cells in the selected blended surface

metrics.formula: Not applicable for this UI interaction change.

verification: Static content checks for panZ state, camera center panZ, vertical pivot rotation function, Ctrl+drag call site, and no pitch update in Ctrl+drag
